zh.name: 邵悦
zh.title: 辽宁师范大学 · 讲师 · 硕士生导师
zh.location: 辽宁师范大学 · 理化楼 A503
bio: 1996 年生，辽宁阜新人。主要研究方向为宇宙黎明与再电离时期的 21 cm 信号，已在 Nature Astronomy、Physical Review D 等国际主流 SCI 期刊发表论文 10 余篇。
曾获东北大学 2023 年博士研究生国家奖学金。研究成果被 Nature Astronomy 选为 2023 年 9 月封面文章，并在东北大学百年科技展中展出。参与 FAST 核心阵科学白皮书、国际 SKA 科学白皮书撰写。

education.degree: 应用物理学专业 · 学士

interests.name: 21 cm 森林
interests.description: 利用 SKA 等射电望远镜的 21 cm 森林观测，探测宇宙再电离、暗物质粒子、原初黑洞和中微子质量等。

interests.name: 纳赫兹引力波
interests.description: 利用脉冲星计时阵列探测的超大质量黑洞双星引力波信号作为标准汽笛，约束宇宙学参数。

interests.name: 多探针联合
interests.description: 研究引力波、21 cm 信号与快速射电暴等晚期宇宙探针的协同约束。

highlight.title: 21 cm 森林：同时探测暗物质与宇宙加热历史
highlight.description: 该成果发表于 Nature Astronomy，并入选 2023 年 9 月期刊封面。相关工作利用高红移背景射电源的 21 cm 森林信号，为同时约束暗物质性质和早期宇宙热历史提供了新路径。

en.name: Yue Shao
en.title: Lecturer · Master's Supervisor · Liaoning Normal University
en.location: Liaoning Normal University · Science Building A503
bio: Born in 1996 in Fuxin, Liaoning, I work on the 21 cm signal from cosmic dawn and the epoch of reionization. I have published more than ten papers in journals including Nature Astronomy and Physical Review D.

I received the 2023 National Scholarship for Doctoral Students at Northeastern University. My work was selected for the September 2023 cover of Nature Astronomy and featured in Northeastern University's Centennial Science and Technology Exhibition. I also contributed to the FAST Core Array and international SKA science white papers.

interests.name: 21 cm Forest
interests.description: Using 21 cm forest observations with radio telescopes such as the SKA to probe reionization, dark matter particles, primordial black holes, and neutrino masses.

interests.name: Nanohertz Gravitational Waves
interests.description: Using gravitational waves from supermassive black hole binaries detected by pulsar timing arrays as standard sirens for cosmology.

interests.name: Multi-probe Cosmology
interests.description: Combining gravitational waves, 21 cm signals, and fast radio bursts to constrain late-universe cosmology.

projects.title: Liaoning Provincial Doctoral Research Start-up Project
Liaoning Normal University Doctoral Research Start-up Project

students.title: Graduate Supervision
students.description: I supervise master's students working on 21 cm cosmology, gravitational-wave standard sirens, and joint cosmological probes. Students interested in these topics are welcome to get in touch.

highlight.title: The 21 cm forest as a joint probe of dark matter and cosmic heating
highlight.description: Published in Nature Astronomy and selected for the September 2023 journal cover, this work uses the 21 cm forest toward high-redshift radio sources to jointly constrain dark matter properties and the thermal history of the early Universe.
